title: Add a Locale('he') behavioral variant to StatCard's interactive widget tests (epic_26_story_26_16)
why: StatCard is a core/widgets/ primitive explicitly built for a bilingual RTL app (its own AC6 wants 'golden tests in 3 visual variants, en + he each'), but all 5 interactive testWidgets (text rendering, tap handling) hardcode Locale('en'); only the 3 golden-smoke tests touch 'he', and those skip the actual matchesGoldenFile compare via skipGolden: true. A regression that breaks hit-testing or layout specifically under RTL mirroring (e.g. the tap target shifting when Directionality flips) would not be caught anywhere in this file.
recommendation: Parameterize the 5 testWidgets over both locales, or add an 'he' counterpart for at least the tap-behavior test.
acceptance_criteria: at least one StatCard testWidgets test in this file pumps with Locale('he') and asserts tap/render behavior, not just a skipped golden compare
